name: HEC12 (Hubble)
blurb: HEC12, a globular cluster in the halo of the Andromeda Galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: hec12-hubble
story: A remote ball of stars in the outer reaches of the Andromeda Galaxy. Hubble came back to measure its slow drift across the sky, a clue to how Andromeda grew by gathering in smaller systems.

claims.text: HEC12 is one of the globular clusters in M31's halo targeted for proper motions
M31 is the Andromeda Galaxy; the program studies Andromeda's accretion history
The targets belong to M31's outer globular cluster system
